title: Hearthstone Deck Predictor
shortDescription: Hearthstone Deck Predictor is a WPF plugin for Hearthstone Deck Tracker that predicts an opponent's likely deck in real time. It combines live card-play events with current Standard meta data from HSReplay.net to help players identify opposing archetypes, anticipate likely cards, and understand matchup odds as a game develops.
overview: A real-time Hearthstone opponent deck prediction tool that integrates with Hearthstone Deck Tracker, matches observed cards against current Standard meta decks, and surfaces likely deck lists, archetypes, and matchup information during play.
problem: Returning Hearthstone players can struggle to keep up with a constantly changing meta, making it difficult to recognise opposing archetypes or know which cards they need to play around. Hearthstone Deck Tracker provides excellent information about your own deck, but does not inherently identify the opponent's complete deck from the limited information revealed during a match.
solution: I built a WPF plugin that integrates with Hearthstone Deck Tracker's internal API and listens for opponent card-play events in real time. At the start of a game, the application retrieves current Standard deck data from HSReplay.net and stores it in an in-memory lookup structure for fast matching. As the opponent reveals cards, incompatible decks are progressively filtered out and the remaining candidates are ranked to identify the best-fitting archetype. The UI then surfaces likely cards, predicted deck information, and matchup odds against the player's own most likely archetype.
outcome: The project provides players with continuously refined information about their opponent's likely strategy, helping returning or less experienced players understand the current meta, anticipate threats, and make more informed decisions during a match.
highlights: Integrated directly with Hearthstone Deck Tracker's internal API to react to live game and card-play events
Retrieved current Standard meta deck data from HSReplay.net at the beginning of each game
Used in-memory hash-based lookups and progressive filtering for fast real-time deck prediction
Continuously refined opponent archetype predictions as additional cards were revealed
Displayed likely remaining cards and archetype matchup odds to help players identify threats and play-around opportunities
